canonical.title: IT Conferences & Tech Events in Bangkok 2026

parent.title: Bangkok Weekend: 3-Star Dinner at Sühring + City Guide

siblings.title: Bangkok's 3-star Michelin restaurants
siblings.summary: Bangkok has exactly two 3-Michelin-star restaurants: Sorn (Southern Thai, closed Saturdays) and Sühring (modern German, open Wed–Sun). For a Saturday-evening dinner, only Sühring is available.

siblings.title: Things to do in Bangkok
siblings.summary: Where to stay, which temples are worth it, named street-food vendors, rooftop bars, day trips, and Thai-massage tiers for a weekend anchored on a 3-star Saturday dinner.
